CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_T.help: Make a list with the class and link each to the sacredness of life (Genesis 1:27; Exodus 20:13).
CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_T.feedback: Many acts violate the right to life: murder, mob justice, suicide, unsafe abortion and reckless driving.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_T.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_S.error: Thinks life is sacred only for good or important people.

example.question: Why is every human life sacred, according to Genesis 1:27 and 9:6?
example.wrong_answer: Only good people's lives are sacred
example.correct_answer: Every person is made in the image of God

CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_S.cause: The learner judges worth by behaviour or status.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_S.reveals: Offer "Only good people's lives are sacred" beside "Every person is made in the image of God" and ask the child to choose.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_S.help: Read Genesis 9:6: because God made people in his image, every life is protected.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_S.feedback: Every person is made in God's image, so every life is sacred.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.SACREDNESS_OF_LIFE.LIFE_S.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.error: Names kindness as a cause of bullying, instead of the wish for power, jealousy or having been bullied.

example.question: Which can cause bullying?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.cause: The learner does not know what drives bullies.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.reveals: Offer "Kindness" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.help: List causes: wanting power, being bullied at home, peer pressure, jealousy, prejudice. Discuss each.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.error: Thinks bullying is only a joke with no lasting effect.

example.question: Which is an effect of bullying?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.cause: Bullying is sometimes laughed off as a joke.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.reveals: Offer "Happiness" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.help: List effects on the person (fear, loneliness, falling marks, depression) and on the family (worry, moving schools).
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.error: Picks toughness as the value that stops bullying, instead of love and kindness.

example.question: Which value from Ephesians 4:32 helps stop bullying?
example.wrong_answer: Being tough so no one dares touch you

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.cause: The learner picks any word without linking it to bullying.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.reveals: Offer "Being tough so no one dares touch you" beside "Being kind and compassionate" and ask the child to choose.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.help: Read Romans 12:10 and Ephesians 4:32: love, honour, kindness, forgiveness. Link each to standing up for others.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.error: Thinks a learner who watches bullying and says nothing is not involved.

example.question: You see a classmate being bullied. What does love require?
example.wrong_answer: Stay out of it; it is not my business
example.correct_answer: Stand with the victim and report it to a teacher

CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.cause: Fear of becoming the next target makes bystanding feel safe.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.reveals: Offer "Stay out of it; it is not my business" beside "Stand with the victim and report it to a teacher" and ask the child to choose.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.help: Discuss the bystander: silence helps the bully. Read Proverbs 31:8: speak up for those who cannot.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.feedback: Watching in silence helps the bully. Stand with the victim and tell a teacher.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.BULLYING.BULLYING.M_CR8_B.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..error: Says the first servant received one talent instead of five.

example.question: How many talents did the first servant get?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..cause: The third servant is remembered best.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..reveals: Offer "One" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..help: Draw three bags: 5, 2, 1, "each according to his ability" (Matthew 25:15).
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..error: Thinks the third servant traded and doubled his talent, instead of burying it.

example.question: What did the third servant do?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..cause: The learner mixes the servants' actions.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..reveals: Offer "Traded and doubled" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..help: Read 25:16-18 and match each servant with what he did.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..error: Thinks the lesson is to keep what one has hidden and safe, instead of using it faithfully.

example.question: What does the parable teach?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..cause: The learner thinks keeping safe is wise.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..reveals: Offer "Hide what you have" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..help: Read 25:25-27: fear made him hide it; the master wanted it used.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..error: Misses why the third servant hid his talent: he was afraid and thought the master hard.

example.question: Why did the third servant bury his talent (Matthew 25:24-25)?
example.correct_answer: He was afraid and thought the master was a hard man

CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..cause: The learner has not read the servant's own words.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..reveals: Offer "He forgot about it" beside "He was afraid and thought the master was a hard man" and ask the child to choose.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..help: Read 25:24-25 and discuss fear as a reason people do not use their gifts.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..feedback: He was afraid and hid it. Fear can stop us using the gifts God gave us.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.WORK_TALENTS_GIFTS_AND_A..source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.error: Thinks leisure means hard work, instead of free time after duties.

example.question: What is leisure?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.cause: The learner confuses free time with chores done in free time.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.reveals: Offer "Hard work" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.help: Define leisure: free time after work and duties, for rest and good activities.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.error: Calls reading a misuse of leisure, linking it with school work.

example.question: Which is a misuse of leisure?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.cause: Reading is linked with school work, so it feels like a chore.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.reveals: Offer "Reading a book" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.help: Sort activities: builds up (reading, sport, hobbies, serving) and pulls down (drugs, gambling, idleness).
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.error: Thinks idling all day is a constructive use of leisure.

example.question: Which is a constructive use of leisure?

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.reveals: Offer "Idling all day" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new situation.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.help: Read 2 Thessalonians 3:11 and Proverbs 6:9-11: idleness leads to trouble and want.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.error: Thinks no values are needed in leisure time because it is free time.

example.question: Which value helps a youth use leisure well?
example.wrong_answer: None: free time needs no rules

CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.cause: Free time feels like time without rules.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.reveals: Offer "None: free time needs no rules" beside "Self-control and time management" and ask the child to choose.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.help: Compile values and life skills for leisure: self-control, time management, responsibility, decision-making. Read Ephesians 5:15-16.
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.feedback: Even free time needs self-control and good choices. Make the most of every opportunity (Ephesians 5:15-16).
CRES.G8.CHRIST.LEISURE.LEISURE.M_CR8_LE_.source: To confirm by a CRE teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.
